share.title: Share: links and files
share.intro: Shorten long links and share files. Off until you turn it on.
share.enable: Turn on link and file sharing
share.unreachable: The sharing service is not answering. Try again later.
share.communityOff: Sharing needs Meshloom Community. Community is off, so sharing is paused; your settings are kept.

banned.title: Sharing banned for this Meshloom
banned.body: The sharing service banned this Meshloom for 12 hours; links already shared still work. A mistake? Write to <email>ban@meshloom.app</email>.

share.termsStale: The terms have changed: turn sharing on again to accept the new ones.

status.identityPending: not yet (created the first time you share)
status.dm: Encrypted files for direct messages available
status.dmUnavailable: Available once the radio is connected.

consent.title: Turn on link and file sharing?
consent.intro: The links and files you share go through the Meshloom sharing service. <docs>Learn more</docs>
consent.accept: I accept the <terms>terms</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

shorten.legend: Shorten links when you write a message
shorten.autoHelp: On send, links over 26 characters are shortened. If the service does not answer, they go out as typed.
shorten.alwaysHelp: Every link is shortened on send. If the service does not answer, the message is not sent.
shorten.neverHelp: Links are sent as you typed them.

preview.legend: Previews of shared images and links
preview.privateHelp: Not fetched in public channels, where anyone can post a link.
preview.neverHelp: Nothing is fetched; open an item yourself to see it.
